scoring_justification: Recompute expected percentages from the paper's analytic formulas (Eqs. 19-20) with x_b/x_h=0.1; compare agent's percentages against these recomputed gold values with tolerance of ±1 percentage point.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected divacancy contribution percentages for high and low temperature regimes, derived from the analytic formulas
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Eqs. (19)-(20) and concentration ratio x_b/x_h=0.1
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are exact values produced by the paper's own analytic formulas, not arbitrary numbers.

outputs.description: Divacancy contribution percentages to the total resistivity increase at high temperature (T>Θ) and low temperature (T<Θ).

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the expected percentages from the paper's analytic formulas using the same concentration ratio and compares with a tolerance of ±1 percentage point.
